satellite_vqa.description: Single-image visual question answering for optical remote sensing.

temporal_comparison.description: Multi-temporal change detection and comparison between T1 and T2.

optical_sar_fusion.description: Multimodal interpretation correlating optical imagery with SAR proxy data.

limitations: Prompt engineering acts as zero-shot adaptation; it is NOT model fine-tuning.
Geospatial reasoning is approximate and image-relative, not metric/GIS accurate.
Visual SAR correlation is performed on amplitude proxies, not raw polarimetric phase data.
